stories.title: Flintshire County Council admits resource pressures behind missed bin collections
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council’s Streetscene and Transportation Department says operational and resource pressures are responsible for a number of missed bin collections around the county. stories.title: Two apartments and beer garden approved at Gwernymynydd’s Owain Glyndŵr Inn
stories.summary: An 18th century Flintshire coachhouse pub will soon be offering short stays after plans were approved. The Owain Glyndŵr Inn in Gwernymynydd has been granted permission by Flintshire County Council’s planning department to renovate the landlord accommodation on the first floor to create two short-stay apartments. stories.title: From dog grooming to Martyn’s Law: Coleg Cambria launches new adult courses
stories.summary: From aesthetics and dog grooming to conversational languages and printmaking, Coleg Cambria has unveiled a diverse new programme of part-time courses for adults this autumn. The September intake brings together professional qualifications, creative subjects and career-focused training designed to fit around work, family and other commitments. stories.title: Flintshire council says Buckley pond fish not in undue distress after inspection
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says the fish in Higher Common Pond at Buckley are not in undue distress, and has ruled out refilling the pond while the drought lasts. stories.title: Free park and ride for Tour of Britain Women stage start in Mold
